config.title: SyncVote Settings
config.wrongCodeAttempts.desc: How many wrong codes a user can type for a room that asks for one before they have to wait (30 seconds, then longer with each further mistake). 7 by default.
config.language.desc: Language of the SyncVote screens. By default it follows the display language of the server.
config.allowPublicRooms.desc: When off, users only see the rooms they belong to or the one of their SyncPlay group
config.autoStart.desc: Start the voting automatically when every member of the SyncPlay group joined the room
config.defaultCanOrganize.desc: Administrators can always organize. Per-user exceptions can be set in the plugin configuration file.
config.injectWebClient: Add SyncVote to the web interface
config.injectWebClient.desc: The plugin adds its own script to the Jellyfin web client. Turn off only if you load it with another plugin. Takes effect on the next page load.
